FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Release
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Version bump for the Steam Workshop release.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Update Specialist Death Handling
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A couple changes to how specialist death is handled.

patchNoteLines.li: The player now always receives a letter if a specialist dies, whether it was in battle or not.
The RNG roll for post-battle specialist death only runs for auto-defense battles

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Backend XML Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Just an update of the xml patches; user-facing behavior shouldn't change.

patchNoteLines.li: Use PatchOperationConditional to patch orbital settlements instead of PatchOperationAdd with success=Always, which is outdated semantics
